info.name: FLOW - Tenant Service CRUD (Full)
info.description:
Full Tenant Service lifecycle — creates a new tenant and tests ALL endpoints:

| # | Method | Endpoint | Step |
|---|--------|----------|------|
| 1 | POST | /admin/tenant | 01 Create Tenant |
| 2 | GET | /admin/tenant | 02 Get All (verify new tenant in list) |
| 3 | GET | /admin/tenant/active | 03 Get Active |
| 4 | GET | /admin/tenant/{code} | 04 Get by Code |
| 5 | GET | /admin/tenant/tenantSpecific/{id} | 05 Tenant-Specific |
| 6 | GET | /admin/tenant/users/{code} | 06 Get Users |
| 7 | GET | /admin/tenant/sso/{code} | 07 SSO Details |
| 8 | PUT | /admin/tenant/config/{id} | 08 Configure |
| 9 | PUT | /admin/tenant/{id}/{active} | 09-12 Toggle (deactivate+verify+reactivate+verify) |
| 10 | POST | /admin/tenant/user-status | 13 Disable user + verify, 13c Enable user + verify |
| 11 | GET | /admin/audit | 14 Audit Entries |
| 12 | GET | /admin/audit/tenantRequests | 15 Tenant Requests |

| 13 | DELETE | /admin/tenant/{code} | 16 Delete (asserts cleanup status=SUCCESS) |
| 14 | GET | /admin/tenant | 17 Verify Deleted (tenant absent from list) |

**Coverage: all CRUD + delete endpoints**

**Requires:** `--env-var newTenantCode=pmflowtest` (unique code for new tenant)
**Teardown:** PURGE-deletes the created tenant (idempotent; always runs)
